params.title: Wampa
params.lead:
'''Wampa''' is a [[Dark]] [[Creature]] ([[Creature]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
params.versions:
'''Decipher''' — [[Wampa]] (3_93)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_93o)
'''Virtual Original''' — [[Wampa (V) (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth)]] (1104_50)
'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[Wampa (V)]] (1220_21)
params.printed_game_text: ＊凶暴性＝3＋運命数。生息地：ホスの位置。「ワンパの雪洞」か未踏査のマーカー位置にのみ配備する。負けたキャラクターは食べられるか、あるいは「ワンパの雪洞」に移される（犠牲者の相手プレイヤーが選択する）。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Wampa-PSA-92654369.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].
params.printed_lore: ''雪に被われたツンドラを徘徊する狡猾な肉食獣。ワンパはしばしば獲物を自分の巣に持ち帰って保存する。屍肉よりも生きたままの獲物を好んでむさぼり食うのだ。''
params.translation:
'''Title:''' Wampa.

'''Card text:''' * Ferocity = 3 + destiny. Habitat: Hoth locations. Deploy only to Wampa Cave or an unexplored marker location. A defeated character is eaten or moved to Wampa Cave. The victim's opponent chooses.

Printed subtype is 寒冷地生物, not Snow. Habitat uses 位置. Deploy restriction uses 未踏査 rather than unoccupied. Vicious Howl is printed 血も凍る叫び声 3. Lore prints 被われた.

'''Lore:''' A cunning carnivore that prowls snow-covered tundra. Wampas often drag prey to their dens for storage. They prefer to devour living prey rather than carrion.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed subtype is 寒冷地生物, not Snow.
params.notes:
Japanese-language printing of [[Wampa]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
<nowiki />

params.title: Who's Scruffy-Looking?
params.lead:
'''Who's Scruffy-Looking?''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
params.versions:
'''Decipher''' — [[Who's Scruffy-Looking?]] (3_52)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_52o)
params.printed_title: 誰がみすぼらしいって？
params.printed_game_text: どちらかを選ぶ。1：「みすぼらしいナーフ飼い」、「ウーキーとキスする方がましだわ」、「毛むくじゃら、おかんむり」、「こんなはずじゃあ…」、「死の烙印」、「悲しみの雄叫び」、「タキール」、「ケット・マリス」のいずれかをキャンセルする。2：このターンの終わりまでレネックの戦闘力を2倍にする。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Whos-Scruffy-Looking-PSA-85187824.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].
params.printed_lore: ''「照れてるのさ。図星をつかれて怒ったんだ。だろ？」''
params.translation:
'''Title:''' Who's Scruffy-Looking?.

'''Card text:'''
Choose one.

1: Cancel Scruffy-Looking Nerf Herder, I'd Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee, Furry Fury, This Is Just Wrong, Death Mark, Mournful Roar, Takeel, or Ket Maliss.

2: Double Rennek's power until this turn ends.

'''Lore:'''
"She's just embarrassed. I hit the mark, so she got angry. Right?"

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese names the eight cancel targets, including 死の烙印 and 悲しみの雄叫び.
params.notes:
Japanese-language printing of [[Who's Scruffy-Looking?]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
<nowiki />

params.title: We Have A Prisoner
params.lead:
'''We Have A Prisoner''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
params.versions:
'''Decipher''' — [[We Have A Prisoner]] (2_142o)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1302_142o)
'''PC Errata''' — [[We Have A Prisoner (PC Errata)]] (2_142)
params.printed_game_text: どちらかを選ぶ。1：敵がキャラクターを戦闘によってロストするか没収した際に使用する。1フォース消費する。キャラクターはロストするかわりに捕虜になる。2：Xフォース消費して、捕まっている宇宙船上のすべてのキャラクターを捕虜にする。X＝キャラクターの人数の2倍である。[[:File:Japanese-ANH-We-Have-A-Prisoner-PSA-90960103.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].
params.printed_lore: ''「貴方は反乱同盟の一党で反逆者だ。連行しろ！」''
params.translation:
'''Title:''' We Have A Prisoner.

'''Card text:'''
Choose one.

1: Use when the opponent loses or forfeits a character from battle. Spend 1 Force. The character becomes a captive instead of being lost.

2: Spend X Force to make all characters on a captured starship captives. X is twice the number of characters.

'''Lore:'''
You are a member of the Rebel Alliance and a traitor. Take this person away!

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face numbers the two options.
params.notes:
Japanese-language printing of [[We Have A Prisoner]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />

params.title: You Have Failed Me For The Last Time
params.lead:
'''You Have Failed Me For The Last Time''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
params.versions:
'''Decipher''' — [[You Have Failed Me For The Last Time]] (3_53)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_53o)
params.printed_title: 貴様の失策につきあうのもこれが最後だ
params.printed_game_text: 場にベイダーが出ている場合に、相手が戦闘を宣言した直後に使用する。戦闘に参加している運命数＜6の相手のリーダーを目標とする。相手が戦闘に勝利しなかったなら、目標は没収値＝0となり、即座にロストする。オゼルであれば除外カードとなる。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-You-Have-Failed-Me-For-The-Last-Time-PSA-85187828.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].
params.printed_lore: ''「ベイダー卿。艦隊は光速を脱し、これより……うわっ……うぐ……ぐえっ」''
params.translation:
'''Title:''' You Have Failed Me For The Last Time.

'''Card text:'''
If Vader is on table, play just after the opponent declares a battle. Target an opponent's leader in that battle with destiny less than 6. If the opponent did not win, the target's forfeit becomes 0 and it is immediately lost. If it is Ozzel, it becomes an excluded card.

'''Lore:'''
Lord Vader. The fleet has left lightspeed, and from now... whoa... ugh... gueh.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Title is a translated movie line, not a literal English title.
params.notes:
Japanese-language printing of [[You Have Failed Me For The Last Time]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />

'''You Will Go To The Dagobah System''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
params.versions:
'''Decipher''' — [[You Will Go To The Dagobah System]] (3_54)
'''Decipher (Japanese)''' — '''this printing''' (1303_54o)

'''Virtual Modern''' — [[You Will Go To The Dagobah System (V)]] (225_59)
params.printed_title: おまえはダゴバ星系に行くのだ
params.printed_game_text: 自分の支配フェイズに２フォース消費して[Hoth]がついた自分の任意の能力値＞1のキャラクターを1人、自分の人員がいる[Dagobah]がついたロケーションに移動させる。ダゴバの位置に移動させるなら、移動にはフォースを消費せず、そこに人員がいる必要もない。[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-You-Will-Go-To-The-Dagobah-System-PSA-93899917.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].
params.printed_lore: ''「そこでお前はヨーダから学ぶ。私の師たるジェダイ・マスターだ」''
params.translation:
'''Title:''' You Will Go To The Dagobah System.

'''Card text:'''
During your control phase, use 2 Force to move one of your [Hoth] characters of ability greater than 1 to a [Dagobah] location where you have presence. If moving to a Dagobah location, the move costs no Force and does not need presence.

'''Lore:'''
There you will learn from Yoda. He is the Jedi Master who taught me.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Paid move costs 2 Force; English costs 1 Force.

Japanese-language printing of [[You Will Go To The Dagobah System]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103.
